text:
carla: deploy-bot paused the promotion — staging artifacts failing to upload, multipart chunks timing out and cache shard write queue is blowing up.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused (reason: artifact_write_backpressure).

carla: logs:
```
uploader: chunk write timeout after 26s
registry: 503 slow_down x 22
cache-shard-4: queue_depth=940, evictions=high
```

henry: Seen this before when shard hotspots coincide with many concurrent chunk uploads. Quick options: reduce multipart concurrency, switch to eu-west fallback registry, or pin to last-good SHA and rerun CI.

carla: Change window in ~48m. I prefer pin + rerun to avoid a rollback inside the window. Anyone object?

henry: +1 for pin. Lower concurrency on retry too.

release-coordinator: Agreed. I'll mark the cut as "held - pinned" and note the manual pin in release notes.

carla: Opening promo pin: https://deploybot/internal/pins/3172000123  pinned sha256:6e2f4b8a. Rerun will use multipart_concurrency=3.

ci-bot: Rerun queued on pinned image: pipeline #6110 (staged).

ops-oncall: Investigating cache-shard-4. Observing high tail write latency and small write amplification. Temporarily scaling shard group and increasing write buffer. Collecting uploader traces and shard metrics. ETA ~9m.

henry: Adding checklist to ticket: uploader traces, shard write latencies (P50/P95/P99), registry 503 counts, deploy-bot backpressure counters, multipart chunk size histogram.

release-coordinator: Release notes draft: "Promo held and pinned to last-known-good image due to artifact upload backpressure; infra investigating cache shard saturation. If infra stabilizes within window, we will unpin and proceed; otherwise promotion rescheduled to next change window."

carla: Holding decision for 10m while ops stabilizes. Posting status to #release-updates.

ops-oncall: Quick update: scaled shard group and bumped buffer. Queue depth trending down, 503s decreasing. Recommend waiting 6m for stability then consider unpin.

carla: Thanks. Will wait and then either unpin or keep the promo scheduled for next window.
